float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: Float32 phase accumulation wrapped to [-pi, pi) and cos/sin on both sides, after a Gaussian FIR in float32: errors of a few ulps of the phase (1e-7 rad per step) accumulate over about 1000 samples like a random walk; measured 2e-5.

fixed_vs_float.rationale: Gaussian taps and NRZ values in Q14, the phase in 32 bits, a 4096 entry sine table rounded to the nearest: phase error pi/4096 = 7.7e-4 rad plus the amplitude gain and tap rounding (about 1e-4): under 2e-3 in magnitude.
